The horizontal axis is categorical with one bar per category arranged left to right in the displayed order (no explicit sorting cue is visible), and there is no x-axis label shown. There are 12 pastel-colored bars (each a distinct muted color) with numeric value labels printed above them; from left to right the annotated bar values are approximately 15.15, 25.66, 9.60, 11.37, 28.29, 18.80, 21.88, 23.79, 17.27, 22.41, 23.47, and 24.01 percent, with the shortest bar at about 9.60% and the tallest at about 28.29%.
